purpose: Whole-project clean rebuild of the Lean project of release v1.19.0 (adds version 2 of Paper 10).
result: 3011 of 3011 modules compiled; 3010 of 3011 replayed with leanchecker; the module Research has no constants and was exempted; 0 audit problems. Two passes: see runs.
computer: the author's Windows computer (63 GB of memory, 16 logical CPUs)
procedure: New empty output directory; sources copied from the release tree lean/ (Research.lean and Research/, 3013 files, of which 3011 are Lean modules). After the build their SHA-256 hashes were compared with the release tree: no difference. The directory Comparator/ was not built here; it is unchanged since version 1.13.0, and the CI workflow checks it.
Each module compiled with lean -DautoImplicit=false -DrelaxedAutoImplicit=false, then each module replayed with leanchecker, by the driver build6.py of version 1.16.0. This is not a lake build.

Warnings are recorded and do not fail a module; an error, sorry or non-zero exit code does. The driver reruns a module automatically (up to three times in pass 1, up to five in pass 2) when an attempt ends in a memory or file-read failure rather than a Lean verdict; logs of earlier attempts are kept with the suffix .attemptN.
In the published logs the local workspace directory is replaced by <workspace>; the directory of the pinned toolchain and packages (ai4math-lean-worker) by <worker>; nothing else is changed.

runs.note: Compile phase until 2026-11-11T01:02:40Z, leanchecker phase until 05:34:26Z. 14 attempts in 10 modules of Paper 7 ended without a Lean verdict (5 failed to read a compiled file, 4 std::bad_alloc, 3 'INTERNAL PANIC: out of memory', 1 empty log, 1 log cut off); 8 of these modules passed when run again automatically. Two did not: MomentB4Block00C10 (one std::bad_alloc, then three failed reads) and MomentGapD_00_03_00 (log cut off, not recognized as a memory failure). The 84 modules depending on them were skipped. status-pass1.json is the status at the end of this pass.

The same driver with --retry-failed and up to five automatic reruns: the 2 failed and 84 skipped modules were compiled, and these 86 modules except the exempt module Research were replayed with leanchecker, every one at the first attempt.
